answer.explanation: Every CompressionFunction invocation in the window fails at handler.py line 37 with NoSuchBucket on S3 PutObject to OUTPUT_BUCKET, while the other three functions succeed. Because the error is NoSuchBucket rather than AccessDenied, this points to a misconfigured target bucket name, not missing permissions, so the IAM layer is not implicated. The live OUTPUT_BUCKET value should be checked against the bucket that actually exists, and the IaC template should be checked for the same mismatch. No tools were available, so this conclusion rests only on the supplied log lines.
